about: Solar Industries India Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells industrial explosives, explosive initiating devices, and high energy materials for mining and defense applications in India and internationally. The company offers industrial explosives comprising bulk, packaged, non-permitted, permitted, and seismic explosives; initiating systems; electronic, non-electric, and plain detonators; cord relays; cast boosters; detonating cords; and aluminum elemented det products.
